'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2027 Palestinian legislative election|Next Palestinian legislative election]]
**[[Vice President of Palestine|Palestinian vice president]] [[Hussein al-Sheikh]] announces that the Palestinian [[Palestinian Legislative Council|legislative]] election planned for November 28 will be postponed, possibly until September 2027, along with the also delayed [[2027 Palestinian presidential election|presidential election]], because of worsening conditions throughout [[Palestine]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/palestinians-set-delay-legislative-elections-due-worsening-conditions-letter-2026-10-09/ (Reuters)]
*[[2026 Czech Senate election]], [[2026 Czech municipal elections]]
**[[Czechia|Czechs]] begin voting in the first round to elect one-third of the [[Senate of the Czech Republic|Senate]]. Incumbent [[Prime Minister of the Czech Republic|prime minister]] [[Andrej Babiš]] seeks gains of his [[Third cabinet of Andrej Babiš|coalition]] in the Senate. Municipal elections are also underway. [https://apnews.com/article/czech-republic-senate-local-elections-babis-bee8e7b0718b79323f8ad6946c8ba558 (AP)]
* The [[Government of Mauritania|Mauritanian government]] of [[Prime Minister of Mauritania|Prime Minister]] [[Moctar Ould Diay]] resigns over power outages. However, [[President of Mauritania|President]] [[Mohamed Ould Cheikh El Ghazouani]] reappoints Diay, asking him to form a new government. [https://www.arabnews.com/world/mauritanian-pm-reappointed-hours-after-resignation-over-power-outages-3005549 (AFP via ''Arab News'')]
*[[Pope Leo XIV]] approves [[Catholic Church in the Philippines|Filipino]] [[List of Filipino cardinals|cardinal]] [[Luis Antonio Tagle]]'s election as [[Dean of the College of Cardinals|dean]] of the [[College of Cardinals]], making him the first Asian to lead the body that [[Conclave|elects]] a new [[pope]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/pope-leo-approves-tagle-first-asian-dean-catholic-cardinals-2026-10-09/ (Reuters)]
